benchmark: FIN-EFFECT-004 Profile-Bound Economic Effect Vector Projection

claim_profile_digest.derived_from: profile_id, claim_name, operation_id, expected_intent_fingerprint, sorted required role/owner effects

cases.setup: Both owner effects observed under the bilateral profile
cases.stimulus: Both required roles carry consistent evidence.
cases.assertion: The result is scoped to this exact profile, not external finality.

cases.setup: Payer debit observed; beneficiary claim not observed in a complete view
cases.stimulus: Only the payer owner leg has an effect receipt.
cases.assertion: A payer-side commit does not imply beneficiary receipt.

cases.setup: Member spend observed; pool receipt absent in a complete view
cases.stimulus: The pool-owned receipt is required by the contribution profile.
cases.assertion: Member-side consumption does not establish pool acceptance.

cases.stimulus: The adapter did not provide a batch for one required effect.
cases.assertion: Missing batch is not a complete empty observation.

cases.stimulus: DHT/network evidence has not reached the declared completeness frontier.
cases.assertion: An incomplete view cannot establish absence or presence.

cases.setup: Two receipts assert different effect digests for one role/owner
cases.assertion: Conflicting receipts freeze this profile claim.

cases.setup: Receipt binds a different immutable intent fingerprint
cases.stimulus: The payroll amount or pay-period fingerprint does not match.
cases.assertion: The aggregate layer cannot hide fingerprint disagreement.

cases.setup: Same physical receipt is observed twice with identical bytes/digest
cases.stimulus: Duplicate transport delivery repeats one immutable receipt.
cases.assertion: Duplicate physical evidence collapses and does not multiply value.

cases.setup: Supplier liability observed; beneficiary bank settlement is outside this profile
cases.stimulus: The profile asserts payable recognition only.
cases.assertion: A payable profile must not be interpreted as payment settlement.

cases.setup: Delivery event observed; beneficiary acceptance absent in complete view
cases.stimulus: The claim specifically means accepted fulfilment.

cases.setup: Provider credit observed; recipient debit not yet observed
cases.stimulus: Both sides are required by the bilateral clearing profile.
cases.assertion: One-sided credit is not a complete mutual-credit clearing pair.

cases.setup: Instruction accepted; final settlement receipt absent
cases.stimulus: The claim requires the rail's settlement-finality evidence.
cases.assertion: Provider acceptance is not final settlement.

cases.setup: Evidence supplied for a Treasury role not required by the profile
cases.stimulus: The input includes an unexpected effect batch.
cases.assertion: Unexpected evidence is rejected, not silently folded into the claim.

cases.setup: Same owner and effect role listed twice in profile
cases.stimulus: The profile has a duplicate required effect identity.

cases.setup: Evidence batches and observations arrive in different orders
cases.stimulus: The same set of immutable evidence is evaluated with permuted input order.
cases.assertion: Output ordering is canonical and independent of arrival order.

cases.setup: One required effect conflicts while another required effect view is incomplete
cases.assertion: Conflict dominates indeterminate; neither can yield a supported claim.

metrics.name: Conflict detection recall
metrics.target: 100% of conflicting required-effect fixtures return Conflict

metrics.name: Unknown-to-success promotion
metrics.target: 0 missing/incomplete required slots promoted to supported

metrics.name: Duplicate receipt value multiplication
metrics.target: 0 extra owner effects from repeated identical physical receipts

metrics.name: Input-order determinism
metrics.target: 100% byte-identical canonical projection for all permutations of the same evidence set

metrics.name: p50/p95/p99 projection latency
metrics.target: Measure by number of required effects and evidence receipts; no target until matched baseline

metrics.name: Evidence-read amplification
metrics.target: Measure required/observed reads per effect claim

known_answer_vectors.name: Bilateral payer and beneficiary claim profile digest
known_answer_vectors.encoding: domain separator bytes; u16be schema version; u32be-length-prefixed UTF-8 profile_id and claim_name; 32 raw operation-id bytes; 32 raw intent-fingerprint bytes; u32be required-effect count; for each required effect sorted by raw derived effect-ID bytes: 32 raw effect-id bytes, then u32be-length-prefixed UTF-8 role name and owner; BLAKE3-256 output
